0x19ab453c.notice: Runs the Semaphore + PrivateVoting module initializers. MUST be invoked via the diamond's `initialize` `_init` delegatecall.

params.verifier: The {ISemaphoreVerifier} contract address used to check the anonymous vote proofs.

natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for a PrivateVoting diamond — seeds the underlying Semaphore module with its off-chain proof verifier and registers both the ISemaphore and IPrivateVoting interfaces (ERC-165). Poll and group admin are per-group (set by `createGroup`), so there is NO AccessControl in the recipe. Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; each `__*_init` guard passes because the window is already open).
